command:
set -euo pipefail
pip install -U pip
pip install -e '.[train]'
# Expect SWIFT_GGUF / DISTILL_JSONL provided via job env or pre-download:
#   huggingface-cli download ukisai/Swift-Bonsai-2-GGUF Swift-Bonsai-2-PTQ1_0.gguf --local-dir /data/gguf
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli dequant --gguf /data/gguf/Swift-Bonsai-2-PTQ1_0.gguf --out /data/unpacked
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli distill --prompts data/prompts/distill_seed.jsonl --out /data/distill/train.jsonl --base-url "${TEACHER_URL:-}"
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli train --backend gpu --config configs/train_qlora.yaml --data /data/distill/train.jsonl --out /data/artifacts/train --no-dry-run
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli eval --config configs/eval.yaml --out /data/reports --adapter /data/artifacts/train/lora_adapter
huggingface-cli upload "${HF_USERNAME:-cybort}/swift-bonsai-2-cf-approx-lora" /data/artifacts/train/lora_adapter --repo-type model
command_shell:
hf jobs run --flavor a10g-large --timeout 6h huggingface/transformers-pytorch-gpu bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
pip install -U pip
pip install -e '"'"'.[train]'"'"'
# Expect SWIFT_GGUF / DISTILL_JSONL provided via job env or pre-download:
#   huggingface-cli download ukisai/Swift-Bonsai-2-GGUF Swift-Bonsai-2-PTQ1_0.gguf --local-dir /data/gguf
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli dequant --gguf /data/gguf/Swift-Bonsai-2-PTQ1_0.gguf --out /data/unpacked
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli distill --prompts data/prompts/distill_seed.jsonl --out /data/distill/train.jsonl --base-url "${TEACHER_URL:-}"
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli train --backend gpu --config configs/train_qlora.yaml --data /data/distill/train.jsonl --out /data/artifacts/train --no-dry-run
python3 -m swift_cf_approx.cli eval --config configs/eval.yaml --out /data/reports --adapter /data/artifacts/train/lora_adapter
huggingface-cli upload "${HF_USERNAME:-cybort}/swift-bonsai-2-cf-approx-lora" /data/artifacts/train/lora_adapter --repo-type model
'
notes: Requires HF account with Jobs enabled and a write token.
Mount or download unpacked Swift weights + distill JSONL inside the job script.
Upload resulting lora_adapter/ with huggingface-cli upload.
